sourceTitle: The Seven Periods of English Architecture Defined and Illustrated
description: "The Seven Periods of English Architecture Defined and Illustrated" by Edmund Sharpe is a historical account written during the late 19th century. This book systematically classifies and analyzes English church architecture from the Heptarchy to the Reformation, and serves as a guide to teaching the evolution of architectural styles in England.
